hero.title: Certificates that are earned — and verifiable
hero.description: NYTI certificates are awarded only after learners complete the required training and pass an assessment. Each carries a unique ID that anyone can check online.

steps.title: Find the certificate ID
steps.body: Printed at the bottom of every certificate in the format NYTI-YYYY-NNNNNN.

steps.title: Enter it or scan the QR code
steps.body: The QR code opens the verification page with the ID already filled in.

steps.title: Read the official result
steps.body: The registry returns the certificate's status, holder, course, issuer and issue date.

statuses.title: Valid
statuses.body: The certificate was issued by NYTI or an authorized partner and is currently in good standing.

statuses.title: Expired
statuses.body: Some occupational certificates (for example safety-critical trades) must be renewed after a set period.

statuses.title: Revoked
statuses.body: NYTI has withdrawn the certificate, for example following an assessment integrity review.
